job.question: In the NYC Board of Education Retirement System (BERS) RFP 2024-003 for investment consulting services, how many maximum evaluation points are assigned to the annual fee proposal?
job.expected_facts: 28 points (out of 100). Full breakdown: Program Plan/Narrative 18, Organizational Capacity/Knowledge and Experience 23, Demonstrated Effectiveness 22, Fee Proposal - Annual Fee 28, Fee Proposal - Hourly Rate 9.
job.acceptance: 28 points alone is sufficient. Other scoring categories and fee formula are optional.

reviews.reason: This is a Boston Retirement System proposal questionnaire, not NYC BERS RFP 2024-003. Its fee proposal section gives a fee schedule but no maximum evaluation points for the annual fee proposal.
